backtest.disclaimer: SEM+ predicts next-year run prevention out of sample. Durability (innings, games started, average start length) is shown as context because it is workload, not run-prevention rate.

multiyear.note: 3-year SEM+ is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from sem_plus_multiyear_eval.json, not recomputed by this run. It is as of generated_at, NOT as of this board's as_of date, and starters who joined the pool after that date have no value.

war_rate.note: 100 + 10z of bWAR per IP over starters with 20+ IP. Ten points is one standard deviation of that pool, not one percent: this is not the HEM+/REM+/SEM+ ratio scale. No shrink and no clamp. Rows under 40 IP carry no value.
war_rate.adj_note: war_ip_plus_adj regresses the rate toward the pool rate by sample size (K = pool median IP = 99) and re-standardises on the SHRUNK pool. It is a readability aid for thin samples, not a forward claim: the ship gate G2 failed on every pool, and the post-hoc volume control shows the shrink gain is mostly a volume leak. It does NOT reproduce war/ip on the row.

multiyear_war_rate.note: The 3-year column is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from war_rate_plus_multiyear_eval.json, not recomputed by this run. It is as of generated_at, NOT as of this board's as_of date, and starters who joined the pool after that date have no value.

team_basis.label: pitching 2026
team_basis.note: current_roster points `team` at the club MLB's transaction feed says employs the player today, for the charts AND the aggregates, so an August acquisition credits his whole season to his new club. stats_earned keeps the club the stats were earned with. n_team_unresolved counts rows serving a blank team; those rows are absent from every team rollup.
